Offroad_TemperatureTooHigh.text: Device temperature too high. System cooling down before starting. Current internal component temperature: %1

Offroad_ConnectivityNeededPrompt.text: Immediately connect to the internet to check for updates. If you do not connect to the internet, openpilot won't engage in %1
Offroad_ConnectivityNeededPrompt._comment: Set extra field to number of days

Offroad_ConnectivityNeeded.text: Connect to internet to check for updates. openpilot won't automatically start until it connects to internet to check for updates.

Offroad_UpdateFailed._comment: Set extra field to the failed reason.

Offroad_ChestnutBranch.text: Chestnut detected! Switch to the release-chestnut branch to use chestnut-class models.

Offroad_ChestnutNotDetected.text: Chestnut not detected. Check USB and 12V connections.

Offroad_ChestnutOverheated.text: Chestnut overheated. Ensure good airflow. Current GPU temperature is %1.

Offroad_ChestnutUncompiled.text: Chestnut model not compiled. Keep ignition on and reboot the comma.

Offroad_ChestnutUpdateFailed.text: Chestnut update failed. Check the USB cable.

Offroad_ChestnutUsbSlow.text: Chestnut USB link is slow. Check the USB cable. The current speed is %1.

Offroad_UnregisteredHardware.text: Failed to register with comma.ai backend. It will not connect or upload to comma.ai servers, and receives no support from comma.ai. If this is a device purchased at comma.ai/shop, open a ticket at https://comma.ai/support.

Offroad_CarUnrecognized.text: openpilot was unable to identify your car. Your car is either unsupported or its ECUs are not recognized. Please submit a pull request to add the firmware versions to the proper vehicle. Need help? Join discord.comma.ai.

Offroad_Recalibration.text: openpilot detected a change in the device's mounting position. Ensure the device is fully seated in the mount and the mount is firmly secured to the windshield.

Offroad_DriverMonitoringUncertain.text: Poor visibility detected for driver monitoring. Ensure the device has a clear view of the driver. This can be checked in the device settings. Extreme lighting conditions and/or unconventional mounting positions may also trigger this alert.

Offroad_ExcessiveActuation.text: Excessive %1 actuation detected on your last drive. Please contact support at https://comma.ai/support and share your device's Dongle ID for troubleshooting.
Offroad_ExcessiveActuation._comment: Set extra field to lateral or longitudinal.
